proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Weapon Mastery is always-on — there is no activation moment, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family ('activation') mandates UseCountResource and RestResetCadence, both of which are structurally inapplicable to a passive persistent capability grant. Forcing the feature into 'activation' would require fabricating a use_count with no SRD basis.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_mastery_access variant of ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is 'can use mastery properties of N chosen weapon types'. This is neither grant_extra_action nor heal_hp. The v4 atom grant_proficiency is the closest taxonomy atom, but it is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union and wouldn't carry the 'chosen weapon category' parameter or the level-scaled count.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. [...] you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Fighter Features table.

proposed_widenings.name: long_rest_reconfiguration surface shape
proposed_widenings.justification: On each Long Rest the fighter may swap one of their chosen weapon types. This is a periodic reconfiguration of a selection set, not a resource refill. No existing RestResetCadence variant or surface shape captures 'change one element of a chosen set per long rest'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

notes: The unit is a class feature with kind=class_feature, so the top-level UnitRecord kind exists. The gap is entirely within ClassFeatureMechanics: the sole existing family ('activation') requires a use-count resource and a discrete activation moment, neither of which applies here. A new 'passive_grant' family is needed, parameterized by: (a) a scalable weapon-type count (threshold_tiers by class level), (b) a weapon category filter ('simple or martial'), and (c) a long-rest-reconfiguration shape. The level-scaling of the count (3 at L1, growing per the Weapon Mastery table) would use ThresholdTiers<number> with axis='class', which already exists in the surface type — so the scaling machinery itself is available, only the family wrapper and effect variant are missing.
